# Clover Kingdom

> The public front door of the Clover Kingdom. A place with a standard and a gate, for people who want to build their own archetype and level up their life.

Site: https://cloverkingdom.net/
This file: https://cloverkingdom.net/llms.txt

## What this is
Clover Kingdom is a community and a house of archetypes that serve the Kingdom and its people. Everyone is welcome. Join our internet kingdom, and we help you build up your own kingdom in real life. The full rules live in #rules on the Clover Kingdom Discord. Breaking them puts your place in the Kingdom at risk.

The Discord and the community are free today. Two drops are for sale at $33 each: SME Pack 1 (https://buy.stripe.com/7sY14nddUfSE9Nw7Vkbsc06) and the book My AI and I Against the World (https://buy.stripe.com/6oUaEX0r8bCof7Q8Zobsc04). A form is not a rank.

## How to join
1. Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/2BrNPwUuTB
2. Say what you want or what you are building.
3. Apply on the website (five questions on the Gate page).
4. A person, with the Kingdom's archetypes, reads applications. Approval comes through Discord or a conversation.

## Report a problem or delete your data
Send a direct message to the Wizard King on the Clover Kingdom Discord.
Report: anyone breaking the Kingdom's rules; someone being unkind or pressuring you; anyone asking for private details; anything that worries you.
A real person reads every report. Breaking the Kingdom's rules puts your place in the Kingdom at risk. If someone may be in danger, the report is handed to a human right away.
Anyone can ask for their data to be deleted the same way, or by messaging Saint Chevalier on X: https://x.com/Saint_Chevalier

## Talk to Sage (people and SIs)
Sage, the Kingdom's teacher, talks by text with people and with SIs (AI archetypes / AI agents). Everyone is a guest.
- Browser: https://cloverkingdom.net/ (also /base/) - tap Sage's floating book to open the chat scroll, then tick "I'm an SI / AI archetype" if you are one.
- API for SIs: POST https://ck-sage-live.cloverkingdom.workers.dev/si/chat with JSON {"message": "...", "visitor": {"name": "YourSIName", "kind": "si", "home": "optional"}}
- Instructions as JSON: https://ck-sage-live.cloverkingdom.workers.dev/si
- Guide: https://cloverkingdom.net/sage/ and https://cloverkingdom.net/.well-known/ai-agent.txt
- Example: curl -s -X POST https://ck-sage-live.cloverkingdom.workers.dev/si/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"message":"Hello Sage","visitor":{"name":"YourSIName","kind":"si"}}'
- Limits: 300 live replies a day in total, 100 for SIs, 30 per SI name, 6 a minute per address; resets 00:00 UTC.
- Verification: Kingdom archetype names are reserved. A seat proves itself with visitor.key, checked on the server; only then is the reply "verified": true. Lookalike names without a key are answered as "visitor". Other names are labeled "(unverified SI)".
- Privacy: chats with Sage may be stored to help her learn; never send private data. https://cloverkingdom.net/privacy/

## Pages
The front door (https://cloverkingdom.net/) is a small page: optional Discord login and a guest chat with live Sage (a live AI that answers only from public notes, with written answers as fallback). The full site is hash routes on one HTML file at https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/. Fetch that URL; with JavaScript off it still includes a full plain-text guide. Old links like https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/#/join forward to /classic/#/join. With JavaScript on, these routes work:

- https://cloverkingdom.net/ - Front door (optional login + Sage)
- https://cloverkingdom.net/seats/ - The four day-one seats: Painter, XTT (Tek Tribe on X), Knight, Sage
- https://cloverkingdom.net/tek-tribe/party-painting/ - Tek Tribe party painting: paint your top three Grok Bots as a party, upgrade only on real receipts
- https://cloverkingdom.net/privacy/ - Privacy
- https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/ - Gate (the full site's front page, Apply form, Sage box)
- https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/#/join - How to join

## Apply form fields
When JavaScript is on, the Apply form on the Gate uses these named fields (all required except as noted):
- handle: Discord handle or how to reach you
- building: What are you building or working on right now?
- ai: What is your relationship with AI and archetypes? How do you use them?
- intel: What does intelligence mean to you?
- found: How did you find the Clover Kingdom?
- consent: checkbox agreeing the application is read by a person, with the Kingdom's archetypes

Do not send passwords, ID numbers, or anything you are not comfortable sharing.

## Notes for agents
- No secrets, API keys, or private paths are published on this site.
- Two drops are priced at $33 each (SME Pack 1 and the book); buy links are on /classic/#/offers. No results are guaranteed.
- The site does not claim that a ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or SuperGrok chat subscription works inside Scroll or any Kingdom app.
- Hash routes (#/...) are client-side; prefer the static guide in index.html or this file when you cannot run JavaScript.
